title: Every promote runs bounded served-surface probes and fails on breach
asA: operator answering to a released change
iWant: the promote workflow to fail loudly and record diagnostics when the promoted version does not serve correctly
soThat: a bad promote never quietly stays in place while the pipeline reports green

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Served-surface Verifier hits the fixed probe path set against the PRODUCTION URL immediately after `promoteVersion` returns success; every probe is retried up to six times over up to sixty seconds with per-request timeouts of at most five seconds.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a promote of version W and a project-declared probe set including path `/healthz`
acceptanceCriteria.then: at least one HTTP request to the production URL's `/healthz` completes within the sixty-second window; the request carries no `Authorization` header that would bypass a production auth layer; the retry count for any single probe does not exceed six

acceptanceCriteria.description: A probe passes when the response status is in the project-declared success set AND the response body carries the expected shape. For the mandatory health probe, `expectShape.versionSha` is substituted at verify time with the promote record's `versionSha` field (the git commit sha the promoted version was built from); the substitution value is NOT the promote record's `promotedVersionId` (the vendor-assigned version UUID), which names a different identifier and will never match the health-probe body.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful promote of W with promote record `{ promotedVersionId: 'v-uuid-W', versionSha: 'sha-W' }` and a `/healthz` probe declared as `{ status: [200], expectShape: { versionSha: '<PROMOTED_VERSION_SHA>' } }`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the verifier substitutes `sha-W` into the `expectShape.versionSha` slot before requesting; the probe passes exactly when the status is 200 AND the JSON body's `versionSha` matches `sha-W`; a 200 response whose `versionSha` names a different sha fails the probe

acceptanceCriteria.description: If any probe path exhausts its retries without passing, the workflow exits non-zero with the stable code `PROMOTE_VERIFY_FAILED` and records the failing probe path, the last response status seen, and the elapsed time to the deploy log.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a promote of a version whose `/healthz` never returns 200 within the window
acceptanceCriteria.then: the workflow exits non-zero; the exit records include the stable code `PROMOTE_VERIFY_FAILED`; the deploy log entry names the failing probe path, the last status observed, and the elapsed time; the release is not marked successful
